action: Pinned-source stateless fixture audit for non-default clientCapabilities propagation
result: At pinned modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, crates/rmcp/tests/test_stateless_server_requests.rs does dispatch modern ListTools requests through the stateless server path, but complete_meta_for always writes ClientCapabilities::default(). The positive context test stateless_server_uses_each_requests_client_context records only context.client_info().name for two requests and never asserts handler-visible RequestMetaObject/clientCapabilities. Its malformed-metadata test sends io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities = null only as a negative validation case. A sibling unit test, crates/rmcp/tests/test_meta_helpers.rs, proves RequestMetaObject can decode a non-default sampling capability from wire-shaped metadata, but it does not dispatch that metadata through the stateless ListTools server path. Therefore the pinned upstream stateless request fixture lacks the exact positive non-default clientCapabilities propagation assertion sought by the continuation.
smallest_source_level_test_gap: Extend or add a sibling stateless ListTools request test so request metadata contains a non-default ClientCapabilities value (for example sampling enabled), the handler observes the request metadata through the RequestContext/RequestMetaObject path, and the test asserts the non-default capability survives dispatch. The existing complete_meta_for helper and ContextServer test already provide the request/dispatch scaffold; the missing piece is a non-default capability plus handler-visible metadata assertion.
